fact: With close linkages between the national ID and civil registration systems, Lesotho provides its population with a unique, verifiable identity from birth to death, with 44.5 percent of under-5s registered in 2018 and a death registration rate of 38 percent in 2019.
title: National ID in Lesotho is putting citizens at the center
publisher: Citizenship Rights in Africa Initiative (source: World Bank)
